judgments.description:
Current opening: 'Skyvern's REST API lives at `https://api.skyvern.com/v1`. Every request must include your API key in the `x-api-key` header.'

What's missing: The opening jumps straight into the base URL and authentication mechanics without first telling the developer WHAT the API enables them to do or WHY they'd use it. There's no framing of the API's purpose or scope.

Suggested stronger opening sentence: 'The Skyvern API lets you programmatically launch, monitor, and control browser automation tasks — use it to integrate Skyvern's web agents directly into your own applications and workflows.'
